newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's Hayleys dips 2.38 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's Hayleys dips 2.38 percent.

text.p: Shares of Hayleys Ltd fell 2.38 percent or five rupees to 205 rupees in late Wednesday trade, as the share adjusted to market levels after a sharp rise on Tuesday, brokers said.
"The share, which rose to 210 rupees on Tuesday for a parcel of 49,000 shares, is adjusting back to market levels," said a local broker.
Buyers paid a premium on Tuesday in order to source the substantial quantity, he said.
Hayleys Ltd is one of three diversified blue-chip conglomerates trading in Colombo.
